# RFP ACT SACT 26-16 Part C

Request for Proposals (RFP) Force Lethality Enhancement eXtended (FLEX) Modelling and Simulation Study – Part C.

Entities wishing to respond to this RFP should read this document carefully and follow the guidance for responding.

**Bid Closing Date**: Bids shall be received at HQ SACT, Purchasing and Contracting Office, **no later than 10 September 2026, 0900 hours** Eastern Time. No bids shall be accepted after this date and time. No hard copy proposals will be accepted.

[**Click here to open RFP ACT SACT 26-16 Part C Amendment #1**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/rfp026016_part-c_amdt1.pdf)

[**Pricing Matrix**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/rfp026016_part-c_pricing.xlsx) \| [**Questions & Answers #1**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/rfp026016_part-c_qa1.pdf)
